title: When in Doubt Ease Out
hook: "We all say that we wanna keep movement and transitions around 200 milliseconds… but there's amazing things you can do… in a much longer duration."
payoff: Soft-close-drawer demo (screen share), ends hard on "….2, .8, 0, 1 with 400 milliseconds, and you just use it everywhere."
arc: Claim (200ms rule is too blunt) → the exact curve (cubic-bezier .2 .8 0 1 @ 400ms, "that's slow") → screen-share demo of robotic default vs soft-close drawer → hard end on "when in doubt, ease out… use it everywhere."
